children: shares are down nearly 5% over the past week, but the company’s platform upgrades announced on Wednesday could give the stock a fresh catalyst.

The company rolled out new and expanded capabilities across agentic AI, automation, enterprise data, connectivity, and governance, aimed at helping businesses deploy AI agents more broadly while keeping their actions and data within company-defined controls.
'UiPath coding agents are now generally available, while the new delegate AI agent can handle repetitive administrative and testing tasks on behalf of employees.
The company also expanded the 'integration service and data fabric' to connect agents and workflows with enterprise systems and governed business data.
Moreover, the company added new governance tools, including a 'runtime checker' and 'model hub,' to monitor models, agent behavior, access, and compliance across its platform.
Its automation suite is also now available on Linux, giving enterprises with stricter security and data-sovereignty requirements more deployment control.
The updates arrive as the stock has struggled to regain momentum.
19.16% YTD, compared with a 13.43% gain for the S&P 500 (
), leaving it well behind the broader market.

Technically, as per the weekly chart, the stock is trying to stabilize around $13.20, but momentum remains weak. RSI near 42.8 is below the neutral 50 level, while the slightly negative MACD suggests selling pressure has not fully disappeared.
A move above $13.50 could provide an early sign of improving momentum, while a break below $13.20 could put the recent lows back in focus.
UiPath now has a fresh product catalyst. The chart, however, still needs to confirm that investors are ready to buy it.

title: UiPath announces new AI upgrades: Will PATH stock rebound now?
